Market today: The market's getting a boost from strong data-center demand, which is great news for your tech and chip-heavy book. Oil prices are also slumping, which generally helps the broader economy.

Your holdings: SOXL (-54.14%) and SPAL (-56.5%) are both leveraged ETFs showing massive drawdowns and are flagged SELL/NEW. Remember, margin amplifies these drops. SMH (-14.29%) and QQQI (-4.56%) are also flagged TRIM and are close to their stops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on your leveraged positions (SOXL, SPAL) given their volatility and current deep losses. Also, watch SMH and QQQI as they approach their stops.

Bottom line: Focus on managing risk in your deeply underwater leveraged positions and respecting stops on your TRIM-flagged ETFs.
plays: SOXL: Consider adjusting your stop or trimming this leveraged position given the -54.14% loss and SELL status.
SPAL: This new leveraged ETF is down -56.5%. Review your conviction and stop at 21.38.
